description:
Series 10 Smartwatch with 2.09″ large display, Bluetooth calling, and wireless charging is built for people who want a big, easy-to-read screen and quick wrist calls in one daily-wear watch. The 2.09-inch LCD TFT display keeps caller ID, messages, and app alerts clear at a glance—great for commutes, workdays, and workouts. Pair it to your phone over Bluetooth 5.0 and use the built-in mic and speaker to answer calls when your hands are busy.

It tracks heart rate and sleep to help you stay aware of daily patterns, and offers multiple sports modes for walking, running, cycling, and more. With up to 3–5 days of battery backup, you won’t be charging every night. Wireless charging makes top-ups simple, while the splash-resistant build handles sweat and everyday splashes. Compatible with Android and iOS, it’s a practical, value-focused smartwatch that keeps you connected and consistent.

features: 2.09-inch large LCD TFT display: Big, clear screen for caller ID, messages, and activity stats—easy to read while moving or outdoors.
Bluetooth calling (mic + speaker): Answer and talk from your wrist when paired to your phone—ideal for cooking, commuting, and workouts.
Wireless charging convenience: Drop-and-charge power-ups without plugging a cable into the watch for hassle-free daily use.
Heart rate + sleep tracking: Helps you stay aware of daily wellness patterns and rest quality (not a medical device).
Multiple sports modes: Track common activities like walking, running, and cycling to stay consistent with fitness goals.
Smart notifications: See calls, SMS, and app alerts on your wrist so you check your phone less.
3–5 day battery backup: Designed to last several days on typical use, reducing nightly charging stress.
Splash-resistant daily build: Handles sweat, handwashing splashes, and light rain (not recommended for swimming).
Android + iOS compatibility: Works with most smartphones, making it an easy upgrade regardless of your phone brand.
